searchText: I have a question, what if I as a validator am selected in the IL committee for slot *n*, What if I am not active during that period or willingly do not participate in the FOCIL as there is no reward for it atm, what would happen in such case? Nothing really happens, it's just a no-op to the protocol. It makes the inclusion list welfare less effective
